delta_of: ultima8-engine-bridge v1 + v1.1 delta + v1.2 delta
applies_from: CP15 E3 audio/run deliverable (Modern GM FluidLite / Classic FM / always-run / audio status)
host_action: copy contracts/bridge-v1.3-delta.json to the canonical .scratch/contracts path (worker sandbox is EPERM there). Do NOT overwrite bridge-v1.json / v1.1 / v1.2.

meaning.AUDIO_SYNTH: The music driver ACTUALLY in use right now: 0 = none, 1 = Classic FM (engine built-in AdLib/Miles-FM soundtrack, original tracks <128, +128 FM variants), 2 = Modern GM (FluidLite/FluidSynth behind the Miles GM driver). Read from the live MidiPlayer (AudioMixer::getMidiPlayer()) -- the driver created at Midi-open, not the requested conf value.
meaning.AUDIO_FONT_LOADED: 1 iff a general-MIDI driver actually finished loading a usable SoundFont (real fluid_synth_sfload() result != -1, via MidiDriver_FluidSynth::isSoundFontLoaded() / MidiDriver_MT32GM::isSoundFontLoaded()). 0 when FM/None is active or the font failed to load. This is a LOADED-font signal, not a 'downloaded file' signal.
meaning.AUDIO_MUSIC_VOL: The engine's live music_volume mixer value (0..255), read from ConfMan after syncSoundSettings; the same value the mixer applies. Read-only.
meaning.AUDIO_SFX_VOL: The engine's live sfx_volume mixer value (0..255). Read-only.
meaning.AUDIO_LOAD_ERROR: Non-zero iff Modern GM was requested (audio_synth==1) but it is NOT active-and-loaded. Currently 1 = GM requested but no usable font loaded / not the active GM driver. 0 = requested source is satisfied (or Classic FM was requested).
meaning.AUDIO_FALLBACK: 1 iff Modern GM was requested but the ACTUAL driver is the original FM (i.e. the real fallback happened, e.g. font missing/failed). 0 otherwise. Use this to surface 'GM unavailable, using FM'.
meaning.AUDIO_CONTEXT_STATE: State of the ACTUAL SDL3 AudioContext (Module['SDL3'].audioContext.state): 0 = suspended, 1 = running, 2 = closed, 3 = interrupted, -1 = unknown/none. The engine never forces autoplay; the shell must resume on the first real user gesture. Read live every frame.
meaning.ALWAYS_RUN: The live always-run movement option (0/1), the same ConfMan key ('always_run') the U8 avatar mover reads to OR in the real MOVE_RUN movement flag. 1 means any movement uses the running animation/speed exactly as a held run key does.

state_fields.indices_unchanged: 0..52 keep their v1/v1.1/E2b/v1.2 meaning; all v1.3 fields are appended after SCREEN_HASH(52).

meaning.MUSIC_SYNTH: Music source switch (CMD_SET_OPTION, a=MUSIC_SYNTH, b=0|1). b=0 => Classic FM (sets music_driver=adlib); b=1 => Modern GM (sets music_driver=auto, gm_device=fluidsynth). Persists to scummvm.ini. NOT applied live: see 'live_switch' below.
meaning.ALWAYS_RUN: b=0 off / b=1 on. Persists ConfMan 'always_run'. Applied LIVE by the mover on the next movement frame (real MOVE_RUN behaviour); no restart needed.

reused_not_duplicated.note: E3 did NOT add a second volume API. bridge_queue_command(CMD_SET_OPTION,1,v)/(2,v) already sets ConfMan music_volume/sfx_volume and calls Ultima8Engine::syncSoundSettings(); AUDIO_MUSIC_VOL/AUDIO_SFX_VOL read the result back. UI Music/SFX sliders should use OPTION.MUSIC_VOLUME/SFX_VOLUME.

added.bridge_audio_set_soundfont: int bridge_audio_set_soundfont(int ptr, int size) -- stages lazy-fetched General MIDI SoundFont bytes (already copied into the wasm heap with bridge_alloc) into the engine filesystem and points the real ConfMan 'soundfont' key at it, also setting gm_device=fluidsynth / audio_synth=1. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure. NEVER embeds a font in the wasm.

exports.bridge_audio_set_soundfont: int bridge_audio_set_soundfont(int ptr, int size) -- stages lazy-fetched General MIDI SoundFont bytes (already copied into the wasm heap with bridge_alloc). Writes them with the engine's own Common::DumpFile to $HOME/u8gm.sf2 (the Emscripten IDBFS mount, so it survives an explicit restart; NOT the volatile MEMFS root) and points the real ConfMan 'soundfont' key at that absolute path, also setting gm_device=fluidsynth / audio_synth=1. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure. NEVER embeds a font in the wasm. Uses no bespoke FS lookup (no shadowed FS / no Module.FS dependency).

js_glue.state_names: STATE.AUDIO_SYNTH(53) .. STATE.ALWAYS_RUN(60) mirror the C++ names (Ultima8Bridge.STATE).

helpers.setSoundFont(bytes): Uint8Array -> allocates in wasm heap, calls bridge_audio_set_soundfont; returns 1/0.
helpers.audio(): returns {synth, fontLoaded, musicVolume, sfxVolume, loadError, fallback, contextState, alwaysRun} read from the STATE indices above.

live_switch.music_synth: REQUIRES RESTART. The U8 music process (U8MusicProcess) binds the MidiPlayer instance that AudioMixer::openMidiOutput() creates during startupGame(); AudioMixer::closeMidiOutput()+openMidiOutput() would leave the process pointing at a freed driver. Therefore switching Modern GM <-> Classic FM sets the conf and takes effect on the NEXT engine/game start (page reload or re-entering the game). The bridge reports the achieved driver via AUDIO_SYNTH so the shell can show 'applies after restart'.
live_switch.always_run: LIVE, no restart (read by the mover every frame).

defaults.audio_synth: 1 (Modern GM) is the registered default. When no SoundFont has been staged (bridge_audio_set_soundfont never succeeded) the engine has no gm_device/fluidsynth font, so detectDevice() falls back to Classic FM; AUDIO_SYNTH==1 and AUDIO_FALLBACK==1 report that honestly. After the shell stages a font and restarts once, AUDIO_SYNTH==2, AUDIO_FONT_LOADED==1, AUDIO_FALLBACK==0.

shell_ui_hook.note: Model-authored minimal UI hook (OPTION/STATE names, unhide Music/SFX sliders, push volumes+always-run, stageFont helper). NOT applied here; shell tree is separately owned.
